# Khronos OpenGL headers

Official Khronos headers, retrieved 2026-10-30. Copyright/license notices are
preserved in each file. These supply API declarations; no GL renderer library
is bundled.

- `GL/glext.h`: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/OpenGL-Registry/main/api/GL/glext.h`
  SHA256 `d7b6f15b1bb209e08bd6ada36983f8bb40429e66c24083aa2474d55205d97047`.
- `KHR/khrplatform.h`: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KhronosGroup/EGL-Registry/main/api/KHR/khrplatform.h`
  SHA256 `7b1e01aaa7ad8f6fc34b5c7bdf79ebf5189bb09e2c4d2e79fc5d350623d11e83`.
